title: Q-TENANT-TOPOLOGY-1: declare ultrastable-tenants in doctrine/topology.json so the deploy lane owns it, and probe /health from the tick
body:
**Owner:** executor
**Trigger:** executor tick, driver order
**Done check:** file:foundation/topology.py
**Status:** done
**Evidence:** merged #535 and #537; doctrine/topology.json lists ultrastable-tenants live; live settings show TENANT durable_object_namespace after the handoff deploys of b682f84 and 7b4e165; tick metric M-tenants-selftest (service source) reads /health.

The tenant store worker `ultrastable-tenants` was deployed by direct Workers API upload on 2026-11-16 (source: workers repo adapters/cloudflare/src/tenants-worker.js, core/tenantstore). Topology has no Durable Object binding support yet, so the lane cannot redeploy it. Add durable_objects and migrations to foundation/topology.py wrangler_config, vendor the module into this repo, declare the worker, and add a tick step that fetches /health through a service binding and files a breach when the self-test is not pass.
Paths: foundation/topology.py, doctrine/topology.json, seed/worker/src/tick.js.
Acceptance: topology --check passes; the worker is redeployed by deploy-workers; /health selftest pass is read by the tick.

size: M

**Closing probe:** doctrine/topology.json lists ultrastable-tenants as live and its health metric is read by the tick.
